To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed the enantioselectivite synthesis and the stereochemistry of a new lignin derivative, 1.

the enantiomeric resolution of a new lignan derivative, obtained by cyclizing polygamain, was done by preparative enantiomeric HPC, and its absolute configuration at C3 was determined by electronic circular dichorism and nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.
a new poligamina derivative 1 was synthesized, and its enantiomers were resolved by preparative enantiomeric Hplc.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis, enantiomeric resolution, absolute stereochemistry assignment, structural elucidation and biological activity of a new lignin derivative.
the synthesis of a new lignin derivative and its enantiomers.
the synthesis of new lignan derivatives and their enantiomeric resolution, as well as the evaluation of the antimicrobial activity of these compounds.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the (1R)-configuration is essential for the antibacterial activity of the lignans.
the (1R)-enantiomer of 1 was the most active against the bacteria tested.
the (1R)-configuration of the chiral centre at C1 is the one which is associated to the best antimicrobial activity against the bacteria responsible for the caries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a novel aryltetraline lignan derivative was synthesized in a three-step reaction sequence and its absolute stereochemistry determined by NMR spectroscopy and ECD.
we have obtained a new aryltetrelin lignan derivative 1, which was reduced and resolved by HPLC to obtain the enantiomeric pairs (1R, 2S, 3S) and (1S, 2R, 3R).
the (1R)-configuration at the stereogenic center C1 is essential to the biological activity of 1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the absolute stereochemistry of 1 can be assigned by a combined ECD/n.O.e. and ECD/Exciton Chirality methods.
enantioselectivity is important for antibacterial activity and that the (1R)-configuration at C1 is the preferred configuration for antibacterial activity against the Streptococcus spp.
the enantiomeric resolution of 1 was achieved, and that the absolute configuration was assigned by ECD spectroscopy.
